author: Latham, 1790
habitat: 저지대와 중간 고도, 농경지에서 숲 가장자리까지
summary: 타이완을 비롯해 아열대와 열대 아시아에 분포하는 수리다. 낮은 곳부터 중간 고도에 걸쳐 살며, 농경지에서 숲 가장자리에 이르는 넓은 범위에서 먹이를 찾는다. 주로 뱀이나 도마뱀 같은 파충류를 잡아먹고 때로는 작은 새를 쫓기도 하며, 2~5마리가 모여 있는 모습이 자주 보인다.

art.subject: Crested Serpent Eagle (Spilornis cheela), adult: crown and a full, rounded crest on the nape black, the crest lying as a thick black ruff behind the head with a few white flecks showing at its base; upperparts and wings dark brown, with a few small white spots on the wing coverts; underparts brown, the breast plainer, the belly, flanks and thighs covered with small white spots; tail black with one broad whitish band across the middle and a narrow pale tip. Bill grey with a yellow cere; bare lores and skin around the eye bright yellow; iris yellow; legs and feet yellow, the tarsus bare.
art.pose: perched on a branch at the forest edge, watching for snakes
art.scene: lowland farmland bordering a forest edge; no people, buildings or text
art.build: Medium-large, broad-winged raptor, about the size of an Eastern Buzzard or a little larger, with a large rounded head made bigger by a full, bushy crest on the nape and a thick neck. Bill short, deep and strongly hooked, shorter than the head. Legs medium length, bare and yellow, with short thick toes. Perches upright, often hunched. In flight very broad, rounded, paddle-shaped wings held forward in a shallow V, with a broad white band across the flight feathers and a black trailing edge; tail rather short, black with a broad white band.
avoid: Do not paint a white crown or a large yellow bill; the crown is black and the bill grey, only the cere and bare face skin are yellow.
Do not draw a tall, spiky crest standing straight up; at rest the crest lies as a full, rounded black ruff on the back of the head.
Do not paint long, narrow wings; they are broad and rounded.
Do not paint a tail with many narrow bars; the adult tail is black with one broad white band.
Do not paint a pale or white belly; the underparts are brown with small white spots.
